newsitem.title: USA: Map maker Rand McNally may be up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Map maker Rand McNally may be up for sale.

text.p: Rand McNally, the world's largest commercial map maker, may be up for sale, the 141-year-old privately held company said Wednesday.
The cartographic firm said it had retained investment bank Goldman Sachs Group LP "to assist in the exploration of its strategic options for the future, including the possible sale of the company."

The company, based in Skokie, Ill., near Chicago, also calls itself the premier global provider of geographic information in both print and electronic media for travel, reference, education and entertainment.

The announcement said the company made the move because of a desire for future liquidity on the part of its shareholders, because it wanted to continue to grow and because of "attractive valuations for media properties in the current marketplace."
